evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read as an orb-in-claw staff at small size (round head with prong notches, collar, long haft, pommel cap); outline symmetric, A15 error 0.0 on X/Y, top view shows orb centred with 4 evenly spaced prongs.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = haft + oversized orb head, medium = 4-prong gold cage and flared collar cone, small = haft ring, ink/teal grip bands and pommel cap.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised head (oversized orb, outward-flaring curved prongs, chunky collar); haft is a plain constant-diameter cylinder but overall proportions read deliberate rather than primitive.
evidence.V4: Gold parts (collar rim, haft ring, pommel, prong edges) carry consistent chamfers that catch light, but the grip wrap has hard un-bevelled creases between bands giving a kinked, razor outline in the grip close-up, and prong ends are blunt flat cuts.
evidence.V5: No pinches or z-fighting, but minor stray faceting: visible vertical facet bands on the collar cone and polygonal outline on the haft ring in close_collar_studio, slight segment kinks along prong curves, and the front prong's base ends as a cut stub poking out of the cone face.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: kit gold accent, ink dark bands, and one hue (teal) in three values (orb light, haft mid, grip bands light); colourways (crimson, shadow) keep the same structure cleanly.
evidence.V7: 2336 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000): at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material (LF_VertexColor), kit gold/ink plus single hue, chamfered gold trims and smooth shading match the kit look of the anchor weapons.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle at hand/grip origin, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Visible facet banding on the flared collar cone (low radial segment count under smooth shading)

Front prong base terminates as a blunt stub protruding from the collar cone surface instead of blending into the rim

Seat the prong bases into the collar rim (end them inside the rim or add a small socket/boss) so no cut stub shows on the cone face

Add a few more segments along the prong curves and round or point the prong tips consistently
